smoke.pass_condition: at least one successful complete real policy-environment episode; preserve all attempted episodes and nonempty videos

quantization.target_scope: DiT transformer-block attention and MLP nn.Linear; same exact module manifest across quantized arms
quantization.activation: dynamic per-token signed symmetric INT4 qmax7, dequantized BF16 operands; STE during fitting
quantization.effective_bpw_accounting: target weights codes/indices, scales, codebooks and transforms including shared payload once; additionally report all DiT parameters including high-precision exclusions

spinquant.method: SpinQuant-adapted learned local right R128, shared across the Cosmos DiT stream
spinquant.loss: full joint denoiser-output normalized MSE against BF16 fixed-input C8 timestep packets, balanced over 8 contexts and 5 denoising evaluations
spinquant.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update 200; no closed-loop test selection

vq.method: Smooth0.5 plus batched H128, B32 power-of-two Microscaling, additive 2xK256 d4 BF16 codebooks
vq.lambda_normalization: rho times C8 mean initial executed motor-action MSE divided by C8 mean initial per-view future-image latent NMSE; freeze before update1
vq.loss: full 5-evaluation sampler endpoint motor-action MSE plus lambda times mean per-view future latent NMSE at slots 6 and 7
vq.gripper: report continuous error and command change separately; no extra OpenVLA mapping
vq.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update16; no closed-loop test selection

load_balancing.assignment: atomic dynamic bundle claims; each bundle includes all three arms, grouped by arm; worker arm order rotated
load_balancing.priority: long-horizon libero_10 bundles first, deterministic ordering within each horizon tier
load_balancing.persistence: one base model per worker; cache arm banks in host RAM; save and resume every completed episode

execution_boundary: Numerical low-bit policy evaluation; report decoded-BF16/fake-A4 separately from any future native kernel evidence.
